questions.question: The ratio of the mean proportional between 0.7 and 2.8 and the third proportional to 2.5 and 3.5 is:
questions.solution:
Mean proportion

⇒ 0.7 : x ∷ x : 2.8

⇒ x² = 0.7 × 2.8 = 1.96

⇒ x = √1.96 = 1.4

Third proportional

⇒ 2.5 : 3.5 ∷ 3.5 : x

⇒ x = (3.5 × 3.5)/2.5

⇒ x = 4.9

According to question:

Ratio of mean propotional and third proportional = (1.4)/ (4.9) = 2/7

**∴ The required ratio of the mean proportional and third proportional = 2 : 7.**

questions.question: Surbhi can do a piece of work in 24 days. She completed 3/8 of the work and then left it. Amit can complete the remaining work in 10 days. Working together, they will complete 125% of the same work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Surbhi can do a piece of work in 24days

Surbhi after completed (3/8)th work and then left

The remaining work is completed by Amit in 10 days

Calculation:

Let the total work be x units

Efficiency of Surbhi = x/24 = x/24 units/day

According to question:

(3/8) × x = 3x/8 units

Surbhi after doing 3x/8 units left the work

Remaining work = x – (3x/8) = 5x/8 units

Amit done the remaining work in 10 days

Efficiency of Amit = (5x/8) ÷ 10 = x/16 units/day

125% of the work = (125/100) × x = 5x/4 units

Efficiency of surbhi and amit = (x/24) + (x/16) = 5x/48 units/day

Time taken to complete 5x/4 work = (5x/4) ÷ (5x/48) days

⇒ 12 days

∴ Time taken to complete the 125% of the work together is 12 days

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

Let the total work be 72 units

Efficiency of Surbhi = 72 / 24 = 3units/day

According to question:

(3/8) × 72 = 27units

Surbhi after doing 27units left the work

Remaining work = 72 – 27 = 45units

Amit done the remaining work in 10days

the efficiency of Amit = 45/10 = 4.5units/day

125% of the work = (125/100) × 72 = 90units

Efficiency of Surbhi and Amit = (3 + 4.5) = 7.5units/day

Time taken by Amit and Surbhi working together to complete 125% work = 90/7.5 days

⇒ 12 days

**∴ The time taken to complete 125% of the work together is 12 days**

questions.question: The average of 17 numbers is 29. The average of first 9 numbers is 31 and the average of the last 9 numbers is 27. If 9th number is excluded, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 17numbers is 29

The average of first 9 number = 31

The average of last 9 number = 27

**Formula used:**

Average = sum of all the numbers ÷ total number

**Calculation:**

Average of 17 numbers

Sum of all the all the number = 17 × 29 = 493

According to question:

Sum of first 9 numbers = 9 × 31 = 279

Sum of last 9 numbers = 9 × 27 = 243

9th number is calculated twice = (279 + 243) – 493 = 29

If 9th number is excluded = 493 – 29 = 464

Average of 16 numbers = 464 / 16 = 29

**∴ The required average = 29**

questions.question: Anu sells an article at a profit of 25%. If she had bought it at 25% less and sold it for ₹30.25 less she would have gained 30%. What is the original price (in ₹) of the article?
questions.solution:
Anu sells an article at a profit of 25%

If she brought at 25% less

And sold it for Rs.30.25 less than the gain percentage = 30%

**Calculation**:

Let the cost price of an article be 100x

According to the question;

An article is sold at a profit of 25%

Then the selling price = 125x

According to the question;

If the article is purchased at 25% less

Then the cost price = 100 – (25/100) = 75x

And then sold it for Rs.30.25 less

Selling price = 125x – 30.25 ......(1)

Also, at a profit of 30%,

Selling price = 75x × (130/100)

Selling price = 3x × 130/4

Selling price = 97.5x ......(2)

Thus, from eq (1) and (2),

⇒ 125x – 30.25 = 97.5x

⇒ 125x – 97.5x = 30.25 

⇒ 27.5x = 30.25

⇒ x =30.25/27.5

⇒ x = 1.1

Original cost price = 1.1 × 100 = 110

**∴ The original price of the article is Rs.110.**

questions.solution:

⇒ spirit in mixture A = 16litres and water = 20litres

Similarly, spirit in mixture B = 35litres and water = 55litres

According to question:

2 parts of A and 5 parts of B are taken

⇒ Total spirit : total water = (16 + 35) : (20 + 55) = 51 : 75 = 17 : 25

questions.question: Two pipes X and Y can fill an empty tank in ‘t’ minutes. If pipe X alone takes 6 minutes more than ‘t’ to fill the tank and Y alone takes 54 minutes more than ‘t’to fill the tank, then X and Y together will fill the tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two pipes X and Y can fill the tank in “t” min

X alone takes = (t + 6)min

Y alone takes = (t + 54)min

**Calculation:**

Let the total volume of the tank be xunits

X’s efficiency = [x/(t+6)] units/min

Time taken by both pipes X and Y to fill the tank = [{x/(t+6)} + {x/(t+54)}] × t = x

⇒ (2t + 60) t = (t + 6) (t + 54)

⇒ 2t² + 60t = t² + 60t + 324

⇒ t² = 324

⇒ t = √324 = 18

∴ time taken by X and Y together to fill the tank = 18mins

questions.question: A person makes a profit of 17% after allowing 10% discount on its marked price. If he gives 14% discount on the marked price, then his profit percent is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit% = 17%

Discount% = 10%

**Concept:**

Marked price – discount = Selling Price

Cost Price + profit = Selling Price

**Formula used:**

Profit% = {(Profit)/Cost Price} × 100

**Calculation:**

Marked Price × (discount%) = Cost Price × (profit%)

⇒ Marked Price × (90/100) = Cost Price × (117/100)

⇒ Marked Price/ Cost Price = 117/90

⇒ Marked Price / Cost Price = 13/10

Profit = Selling Price – Cost Price

Selling Price = Marked price × (discount%)

⇒ Selling Price = 13 × (14/100) = 11.18

Profit = 11.18 – 10 = 1.18

⇒ Profit% = (1.18/10) × 100 = 11.18%

∴ the required profit% = 11.18%

questions.question: Two trains A and B, 186 m and 200 m long are running at 64 km/h and 80 km/h, respectively on parallel tracks. If they are running in the opposite directions, then how much time(in seconds) will a person sitting in the first train A take to cross the other train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of train A = 186m

Length of train B = 200m

Speed of train A = 64km/hr = 64 × (5/18) = (160/9)m/sec

Speed of train B = 80km/hr = 80 × (5/18) = (200/9)m/sec

**Concept:**

When the two trains are running opposite to each other then the speed of both trains are added

When a person sitting in a train crosses another train, the length of the train that crosses the train in which one person is sitting is taken as the distance

**Formula used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:**

Relative speed when both the trains are running towards each other = (200/9) + (160/9) = 360/9 = 40m/sec

Distance = 200m

Time = 200/ 40 = 5sec

∴ the time taken to cross the man who is sitting in train A = 5 sec

questions.question: The total surface area of a cuboidal box is 240 cm² and the length of its diagonal is 11 cm. What is the sum (in cm)of its length, breadth and depth?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The surface area of a cuboidal box is 240 cm2 and the length of its diagonal is 11 cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29791055c2aaedfc1229cc2eeadc410b36927aa30ce4cd3fe953480afd10c928.png] 

**Formula used:**

Diagonal of cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²)

Surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the cuboid be l

Let the breath of the cuboid be b

Let the height of the cuboid be h

According to question:

Diagonal of cuboid = √(l² + b² + h²)

 ⇒ l² + b² + h² = 121 -----(i)

Surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl) = 240 ----(ii)

Sum of length, breath and height = (l + b + h)² = (l² + b² + h²) + 2(lb + bh + hl)

Substituting values

⇒ (l + b + h)² = 121 + 240 = 361

⇒ (l + b + h) = √361 = 19cm

**∴ The required sum is 19cm.**

questions.question: A man can row downstream a distance of 9 km in 2 hours and takes 6 hours while returning to the starting point. What is the speed (in km/h) of the stream?

When the boat is rowing upstream speed of boat and the speed of stream is subtracted,

When the boat is rowing downstream speed of boat and speed of stream is added

Distance = speed × time

Let the speed of stream be y

According to question:

9km = (x + y) × 2

9km = (x – y) × 6

⇒ 2x + 2y = 9 -----(i)

⇒ 6x – 6y = 9 -----(ii)

Multiply by 3 equation(i)

⇒ 6x + 6y = 27 -----(i)

Solving equation(i) and equation(ii)

⇒ x = 3

Putting value of x in eqation (i)

⇒ 6 × 3 + 6y = 27

⇒ 18 + 6y = 27

⇒ 6y = 9

⇒ y = 3/2 = 1.5

∴ the speed of stream = 1.5km/hr
